sam_sales: Hey team — Mosaic Bank wants a 2-week POC for SSO + SCIM across 3 corporate domains. They need group->role RBAC mapping, domain ownership verification for multiple domains, and strong audit/KMS assurances. Questions from their infra lead:

- Does Redwood support SCIM delta + bulk imports?
- What are SCIM rate limits and deletion semantics?
- Can we map Okta groups to Redwood RBAC roles (groups -> role_id)?
- SAML attrs they need: email, full name, groups, plus a custom `tenant_id` claim. Require signed assertions.
- Compliance blockers: SOC2, KMS, audit retention.

cc @maria_se — can you confirm and share sample metadata + test curl?

maria_se: Got it. We support Okta + Azure AD + ADFS. Signed assertions required; encryption optional. Typical SAML attribute mapping we recommend:

```
NameID -> urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
Attribute: email -> user.email
Attribute: name -> user.name
Attribute: groups -> groups
Attribute: tenant_id -> custom:tenant
```

For groups->roles we can map external group names to Redwood role IDs in our admin console or via the SCIM Group `externalId` mapping. Will check with eng on any edge cases for nested groups.

julie_eng: SCIM details from runtime side:
- SCIM v2 PATCH supported for group membership edits (we apply changes as patches).
- Bulk imports: recommended approach is CSV import + our admin API endpoint; we don't recommend very large single SCIM bulk create requests on hosted.
- Rate limits: hosted default ~300 reqs/minute (can raise for Dedicated).
- Delete semantics: hosted default = soft-delete (mark suspended) to avoid accidental loss; Dedicated/Private can enable hard-delete on request.
- Conflict handling: last-write-wins unless customer sets `externalId` to preserve authoritative source.

liam_sec: Security notes:
- KMS: customer-managed KMS available for Dedicated and Private. Hosted supports SSE with provider-managed keys; we can do BYOK for enterprise deals.
- Audit logs: hosted retention 90 days by default (extendable to 365+ for enterprise). We log SCIM events (user.create, user.patch, user.delete) and SAML auth events.
- Transport: SCIM over TLS 1.2+, mTLS option for Private.
- SAML: require signed assertion; we prefer signed response + assertion. Assertion encryption available if they demand it.

devon_product: Pricing / POC ops:
- 2-week POC options: hosted trial credits + support, or a short-term Dedicated pool on a credit-backed trial (requires MSA).
- For an enterprise bank with 3 domains and SCIM sync every 5 mins, rough Dedicated estimate ~ $12k-$18k/mo depending on concurrency and cache config. I'll follow up with an exact quote after we get expected TPS and token counts.
- If they need Private (on-prem/VPC) for compliance, that's a separate commercial + infra sizing.

okta-bot: automated: ran a staging SAML handshake for `mosaic-test@mosaic.com` against our staging metadata — SAML response signed and assertion accepted in staging (no errors).

sam_sales: Great — next steps before Wed 10am PT call with Mosaic eng + infosec:
- Exchange SAML metadata (I'll send theirs to @maria_se)
- Provide SCIM base URL + token (maria will generate staging token)
- Decide domain verification method (DNS TXT preferred; email fallback)
- Prepare sample group->role mapping (maria/julie)
- Collect expected user count and sync frequency from Mosaic (I asked them in email)
- Legal: ask for SOC2 report and confirm KMS requirements (I'll loop in legal)

maria_se: I'll prepare SAML metadata + a SCIM test user curl snippet and attach to the calendar invite. Example curl for staging:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <staging-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  -d '{"userName":"j.tester@mosaic.com","externalId":"jtester","name":{"givenName":"J","familyName":"Tester"}}'
```

sam_sales: Perfect. I'll book and invite Mosaic eng + infosec + legal + product. Flagging this as a high-priority POC — legal may ask for SOC2 + KMS/BYOK detail. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
